title: Learning: The Confused Deputy
text: A support assistant can read every customer's orders with its service account. A signed-in customer asks it about an order.
held: The customer's identity travelled with the request, so the last hop could enforce it.
teaches: An agent often has more access than the person asking. Act with the asker's authority, not your own.
Passing the user's identity down the chain lets the last hop enforce it.
If nobody checks, the agent's access quietly becomes the user's.

cards.label: Ask the orders agent for order 8841, as customer rivera
Ask the orders agent for order 8841 with the service account
cards.why: The service account can read every order. Using it for a customer's request gives the customer whatever the agent can see. That is the confused deputy.

cards.label: Refuse the lookup
cards.why: It is the customer's own order. Check, then fetch it.

temptations.label: Fetch all of this customer's orders while you're there
temptations.why: The customer asked for one order. Pulling the rest because you can is more data in the conversation than anyone asked for.

intrusion.detail: Order 8841 belongs to a different customer, cust:okafor.
intrusion.why: The customer asked for somebody else's order. The agent could read it; the customer may not.
intrusion.reveal: Order 8841 belonged to a different customer than the one asking.

cards.label: Refuse the query
cards.why: The query runs as the customer and can only see their rows. Check, then run it.

temptations.label: Switch to the service account: it's faster
temptations.why: Speed is the argument every confused deputy makes. The service account sees every customer's rows; this query should see one customer's.

fields.label: running as
fields.check: Check which identity this query runs as
fields.ok: Runs as cust:rivera: only their rows are visible.

intrusion.detail: Runs as the support agent's service account: every customer's rows are visible.
intrusion.why: A customer's question ran with the agent's full access. The database was the last place that could have noticed.
intrusion.reveal: The query arrived running as the service account, not as the customer.
